name: nginx-multisite
description: Installs and operates Nginx with three SSL-enabled virtual hosts, including document roots, static pages, security headers, fail2ban, firewall and SSH hardening, and self-signed development certificates.

name: cache
description: Installs and configures Memcached and Redis, including Redis authentication, runtime and log directories, SELinux-aware deployment, and service enablement.

name: fastapi-tutorial
description: Deploys the FastAPI application with Python and PostgreSQL prerequisites, a Git checkout, virtual environment, database and user, environment configuration, and a systemd-managed Uvicorn service on port 8000.
